story_theme_en: A vegetable garden is a rectangle 18 meters wide and 25 meters long. What is the area of the garden? If the rental fee is 45 baht per square meter per year, how much is the annual rent? What is the perimeter of the garden?
helper_tip: Area of rectangle = Width × Length. Perimeter = 2 × (Width + Length)
hint_th: พื้นที่สี่เหลี่ยมผืนผ้า = กว้าง × ยาว รอบรูป = 2 × (กว้าง + ยาว)

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Area = 18 × 25 = 450 sq m | Annual rent = 450 × 45 = 20,250 baht/year | Perimeter = 2 × (18+25) = 86 meters
